questions.question: Which statement correctly describes the relationship between artificial intelligence and machine learning?

options.text: Machine learning is a subset of artificial intelligence in which models learn patterns from data.
options.why: Correct. Machine learning is one approach to building AI systems.

options.text: Artificial intelligence is a subset of machine learning.
options.why: The relationship is reversed. AI is the broader field.

options.text: Machine learning and artificial intelligence are unrelated technologies.
options.why: Machine learning is the most common way to build AI.

options.text: Machine learning is a subset of generative AI.
options.why: Generative AI is built on deep learning, which is a subset of machine learning, not the other way round.

questions.explanation: AI is the broad field. Machine learning sits inside it, deep learning sits inside machine learning, and generative AI is built on deep learning models.

questions.scenario: A marketing team wants a solution that writes first drafts of product descriptions from a short list of product features.
questions.question: Which type of AI workload should the team use?

options.why: Computer vision analyses images. The input and output here are text.
Correct. Creating new text from a prompt is a generative AI workload.
Speech recognition converts spoken audio to text.
Information extraction pulls existing fields out of content. It does not write new content.

questions.explanation: Generating new content, such as product descriptions, from a prompt is a generative AI workload.

questions.scenario: A company wants a solution that receives an employee request, checks room availability in a booking system, reserves a room and sends a confirmation, without a person completing each step.
questions.question: Which type of solution best meets this requirement?

options.why: Sentiment analysis classifies opinion in text. It cannot take actions.

options.text: An AI agent that has instructions and access to tools
options.why: Correct. An agent can plan steps, call tools such as a booking API and complete a multi-step task.
Image classification labels images and does not interact with systems.
Text to speech converts text to audio. It does not complete tasks.

questions.explanation: An AI agent combines a generative model with instructions and tools, which allows it to take actions and complete multi-step tasks.

questions.question: Which TWO scenarios are examples of information extraction or text analysis workloads rather than generative AI workloads?

options.text: Identifying the invoice number and total amount on scanned invoices
options.why: Correct. This extracts existing fields from documents.

options.text: Writing a new marketing slogan for a product launch
options.why: Creating a new slogan is a generative AI task.

options.text: Determining whether customer reviews are positive or negative
options.why: Correct. Sentiment analysis is a text analysis technique.

options.text: Creating an illustration from a text description
options.why: Generating an image from a prompt is a generative AI task.

questions.explanation: Extracting fields from invoices is information extraction and scoring review sentiment is text analysis. Writing slogans and creating images are generative AI tasks.

questions.question: Which type of machine learning uses neural networks with many layers and underpins modern language, speech and vision models?

options.why: Rule-based systems follow hand-written logic and do not learn from data.
Correct. Deep learning uses many-layered neural networks.
Clustering groups similar items. It does not define the many-layered network approach.
Linear regression is a simple statistical model for predicting numbers.

questions.explanation: Deep learning is a subset of machine learning that uses neural networks with many layers. Generative AI models are deep learning models.
